catalogue: Bright Star Catalogue, 5th Revised Edition (preliminary), Hoffleit & Warren (1991)
selection: Require Vmag, spectral type and coordinates; excludes non-stellar/empty records.
frame: FK5 J2000; proper motions in arcsec/year, RA tangent component includes cos(dec)
precision: HEASARC coordinates as supplied; not a catalogue complete to arbitrary faint magnitudes.
reuse: Astronomical catalogue data from NASA HEASARC. Cite original authors and provider; no external software source copied.
